spans.s: हहल n. A sort of deadly poison.
हहा m. Name of a Gandharva. (See हाहा.)
हाहा (I) m. Name of a Gandharva.
हाहा (II) ind. A double form of हा expressing surprise, grief, or rain, हाहा देवि स्फुटति हृदयं स्रंसते देहबंधः Ut.iii.
हाहा-कार m. 1. a great lamentation or wailing; 2. the noise or uproar of battle.
